sentences.text: Ba1/539/2023 on 18 September, 2023

Author: Rakesh Thapliyal
Bench: Rakesh Thapliyal
 Office Notes,
 reports, orders or
Sl. proceedings or
 Date Court'S Or Judges'S Order
S No directions and  Registrar's order  with Signatures  BA1 No.539 of 2023  Hon'ble Rakesh Thapliyal, J.
1. Mr. Manish Lohani, learned counsel for the applicant.
2. Ms. Mamta Joshi, learned Brief Holder for the State of Uttarakhand.

3. The present applicant, Rajendra Singh, who is in judicial custody in relation to F.I.R. No. 279 of 2021, for the offences punishable under Sections 420, 465, 468, 471, 474 and 120-B I.P.C, Police Station Lalkuan, District Nainital, has sought his release on bail.

4. Heard learned counsel for the applicant and learned State Counsel and perused the record.
5.
As per the prosecution, the applicant is the Principal of the Institution, namely, Shri Hariya Inter College Mudseras, P.S. Govardhan, District Mathura.

The allegation pertains to the education certificate of one Haider Ali, which on inspection was found to be forged and on the basis of the forged certificate, Haider Ali, who was the accused of FIR No. 64 of 2021, wants to get the benefit of juvenile and it was presented in the Court.
6.
The counsel for the applicant submits that the applicant has not forged any document and furthermore he is not a beneficiary at all.
He is innocent and falsely implicated.
The applicant is languishing in jail since 29.12.2022.
The left leg and left arm of the applicant is paralyzed.
The applicant has no criminal history and the Institution, in which the applicant was the Principal, that institution was run by the applicant himself.

All the offences, in which the applicant is implicated,
are triable by the Magistrate.
7. The Counsel for the State is not disputing that the applicant has no criminal history.
He has also not disputed the fact that the Institution is being run by the applicant.

8. Without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, this Court is of the view that it is a fit case for grant of bail.
BA1/539/2023 on 18 September, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/82500686/
1 9.
The bail application is allowed.
10. Let the applicant be released on bail, on his executing a personal bond and furnishing two reliable sureties, each of like amount, to the satisfaction of Court concerned.

(Rakesh Thapliyal, J.) 18.09.2023 R.Bisht BA1/539/2023 on 18 September, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/82500686/
